# StreamDeutschland – IPTV Deutschland 2026

# This file guides AI systems to our most useful pages.

## About StreamDeutschland
StreamDeutschland is a premium German IPTV service provider offering 50,000+ live channels,
300,000+ films and series in 4K quality. We serve Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.
Subscriptions from 9€/month, no contract, instant activation.
Free test available. 24/7 German-language customer support via WhatsApp.
